answer: A fable test guards the garden. Each epoch every alias answers one fresh scenario question in its own words, and each answer is checked against the public archive for any copied run of 12 words or more. A copied run marks the alias as a duplicate operator, so it loses challenge eligibility for 6 epochs and forfeits that epoch reward. Honest aliases keep answering in the same garden epoch after epoch, and the 30 epoch horizon makes one copied answer cost far more than the single reward it could win. The test repeats every epoch, so a copy farm never gets a clean pass twice.
